name: moh731V2023ArtMonthlyBase
description: MOH 731 (Ver. July 2023) 3.1 Starting ART and 3.2 Currently on ART: active clients at the locations in the HIV monthly report dataset (etl.hiv_monthly_report_dataset_frozen) for the month ending on the period's end date -- one row per client -- who started ART this month or are on ART this month, with identifiers and ART details. Carries a flag per figure (age band and sex, as before), which the aggregates sum and the patient list filters on.

join.joinCondition: pn.person_name_id = (SELECT pn2.person_name_id FROM amrs.person_name pn2 WHERE pn2.person_id = hmrd.person_id AND pn2.voided = 0 ORDER BY pn2.preferred DESC, pn2.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1)

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = hmrd.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 8 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = hmrd.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 28 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = hmrd.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 45 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)
CONCAT_WS(' ', pn.given_name, pn.middle_name, pn.family_name)
CASE WHEN hmrd.started_art_this_month = 1 THEN 'Started ART this month' ELSE 'On ART' END
DATE(hmrd.enrollment_date)
DATE(hmrd.arv_first_regimen_start_date)
DATE(hmrd.encounter_date)
DATE(hmrd.rtc_date)
CASE WHEN hmrd.transfer_in_this_month = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
CASE WHEN hmrd.pregnant_this_month = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
DATE(hmrd.vl_1_date)
